root_decisions.reason: The javax-to-jakarta source mechanism precisely explains the failures, but the complete target history contains neither Weld 4.0.0.CR1 adoption nor a maintainer-authored Jakarta recovery.

reason: Twelve module-level observations collapse to one repository relation, and that relation has no historical A2.
